title: Busker: a new song, Rainy Day Promenade
body:
Jim's new busker song: a gentle C-major tune at 80 bpm on a soft triangle wave, quieter (`gain: 0.7`) and with no sparkle. It joins the busker's rotation in `SONGS`.

Mike: heads-up, since the music is part of the art.

Verified: 463 tests pass (the busker song checks cover the new entry), and the build and smoke test pass.

## Story

Idea: A rainy-day song for the busker.
Where: open:busker
Asked vs made: Jim wrote the song and asked for it to be committed.
